CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. City is the City of Palembang.
2. City Government is the Government of the City of Palembang.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Palembang.
4. Regional Apparatus is the Regional Apparatus within the City Government.
5. Office of Women's Empowerment, Child Protection and Community Empowerment is the Office of Women's Empowerment, Child Protection and Community Empowerment of the City of Palembang.
6. Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as UPT PPA, is a Technical Implementation Unit established by the government to provide services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
7. Women are all women who are both inside and outside the household.
8. Child is a person who is not yet 18 years old including a child who is still in the womb.
9. Act of Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, psychological to the victim.
10. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of an act of violence.
11. Reporter is a person, family, and community who sees and hears that an act of violence has occurred against a woman or any woman who becomes a victim of an act of violence by another person.
12. Protection of Women and Children in Conflict with the Law is a form of service that must be implemented by law enforcement officers or security officers to provide a sense of security, both physical and psychological to victims or witnesses from threats, disturbances, terror, and violence from any party given at the stage of investigation, inquiry, prosecution and examination at court hearings.
13. Protection .....
.. ., - 5 -
27. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife or husband, wife and their child, or father and his child, or mother and her child or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
28. Family Resilience is the dynamic condition of a family that has tenacity and toughness as well as contains physical material and psychic spiritual mental capabilities to live independently and develop themselves and their family to live harmoniously in improving physical and spiritual welfare.
29. Community is a group of citizens who inhabit an official government administrative area (at the level of Neighborhood Association, Citizens Association, Village and Sub-district) and cooperate in life for a sufficiently long time and obey existing rules.
30. Religious Leaders consist of Ustadz/Ustadzah, Ulama, Pastors, Priests, Monks, Pedanda/Pandita/Sulinggih and other religious leaders who have gender sensitivity/awareness.
31. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy in order to provide strengthening and recovery for victims of violence as stipulated in a decision of an authorized official.

(5) Bentuk eksploitasi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf e bahwa eksploitasi adalah memanfaatkan segala bentuk potensi baik fisik, psikis dan kecerdasan pada perempuan atau anak untuk keuntungan ekonomi maupun kesenangan pribadi pelaku.
translated_text:
Article 6
(1) The form of physical violence as referred to in Article 5 letter a is that physical violence is any act that results in pain according to medical experts, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and/or causes death.
(2) The form of psychological violence as referred to in Article 5 letter b is that psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person.
(3) The form of sexual violence as referred to in Article 5 letter c is that sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual relations, in an unnatural manner or unwanted by one of the parties for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
(4) The form of neglect as referred to in Article 5 letter d is that neglect is the act of releasing and or abandoning the responsibility of care, nurturing, education and livelihood towards every person who is a family member.
(5) The form of exploitation as referred to in Article 5 letter e is that exploitation is utilizing all forms of potential whether physical, psychological and intelligence of women or children for economic gain or personal pleasure of the perpetrator.

Pasal 8
(1) Dalam upaya perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak dari tindak kekerasan berkewajiban:
a. menjamin hak perempuan dan anak tanpa diskriminasi sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan; b. menetapkan dan melaksanakan kebijakan program dan kegiatan perlindungan terhadap hak perempuan dan anak; c. memfasilitasi pembentukan organisasi masyarakat peduli perempuan dan anak;
d. melakukan kerja sama dengan masyarakat dan/atau organisasi kemasyarakatan dan swasta dalam penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan dan anak dari tindak kekerasan;
e. melakukan rehabilitasi dan pemberdayaan terhadap perempuan dan anak yang menjadi korban tindak kekerasan; f. memberikan perlindungan khusus kepada perempuan dan anak korban dari berbagai tindak kekerasan; dan
g. melakukan tindakan preventif dalam rangka mencegah terjadinya pelanggaran terhadap hak perempuan dan anak. (2) Tanggung jawab dalam upaya perlindungan perempuan dan anak dari tindak kekerasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan oleh perangkat daerah sesuai dengan tugas dan fungsinya.
(3) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai kewajiban Pemerintah Kota sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat ( 1) diatur dengan Peraturan Walikota.
translated_text:
Article 8
(1) In the effort to protect women and children from acts of violence, the obligations are:
a. to guarantee the rights of women and children without discrimination in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations; b. to establish and implement policy programs and activities for the protection of the rights of women and children; c. to facilitate the formation of community organizations concerned with women and children;
d. to cooperate with the community and/or community organizations and the private sector in the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence;
e. to carry out rehabilitation and empowerment of women and children who are victims of acts of violence; f. to provide special protection to women and children victims of various acts of violence; and
g. to take preventive action in order to prevent violations of the rights of women and children. (2) The responsibility in the effort to protect women and children from acts of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented by regional apparatus in accordance with their duties and functions.
(3) Further provisions regarding the obligations of the City Government as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Mayor Regulation.

Keluarga dalam upaya perlindungan terhadap hak perempuan dan  anak bertanggung jawab:
a. melindungi perempuan dan anak dari konflik dan kekerasan dalam rumah tangga yang merendahkan martabat perempuan dan anak;
b. memberikan kesempatan yang sama pada perempuan dan anak mengembangkan diri di bidang pendidikan, sosial, ekonomi, politik dan budaya; dan

Article 10
The family in efforts to protect the rights of women and children is responsible for:
a. protecting women and children from conflict and violence in the household that degrades the dignity of women and children;
b. providing equal opportunities to women and children to develop themselves in the fields of education, social, economic, political and cultural; and
c. preventing the occurrence of violations against the rights of women and children in the household.

Article 13
In order to prevent violations of the rights of women and children from acts of violence, the family:
a. protects women and children from various violations of rights within the household;
b. encourages the formation of a harmonious, educational, independent and responsible family; and
c. serves as a place of initial counseling and mediation for every family member who is suspected of experiencing violations of the rights of women and children.

Article 16

(2) Reporters as referred to in paragraph (1) can be made through complaints:
a. directly or direct findings;
b. through telephone or the like; and
c. through letter.
(3) In addition to handling complaints submitted by reporters, officers at service institutions are also authorized to handle women and children victims of acts of violence obtained through other information.
(4) Further provisions regarding procedures for complaint handling services are regulated by Mayor Regulation.
